acceptanceCriteria: Positive test on route R fails with 403 while two rejection-only tests on R pass with 403: both reported ANCHOR-FAILED and not credited
Same run with the positive test passing: both ANCHORED
Rejection-only test with no success on its route in the run: UNANCHORED warning, cleared by a declared positive sibling
Missing route/actor evidence yields uncertainty, never ANCHORED
Spec requirements, traceability and regression tests added
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1099. A test asserting only a rejection (4xx, error code, denied UI state) can pass for the wrong reason (e.g. a tenant feature flag off makes every request 403) and test-validity credits it as a witness. Add an anchor axis: rejection-only tests are ANCHORED when the same run has a success on the same method+route template for the same actor/fixture, UNANCHORED when none exists (warning, clearable by declaring a positive sibling), ANCHOR-FAILED when the declared/observed positive sibling failed in the same run (blocks crediting). Owning spec: docs/specs/mcp-test-validity-profile-v0.md (or the provider result contract it cites).
title: test-validity: classify rejection-only witnesses ANCHORED / UNANCHORED / ANCHOR-FAILED against same-route successes (GitHub #1099)
